description: You’ll love this spacious and peaceful 58 m² apartment in Paris 10th, overlooking a quiet courtyard. Recently refurbished, it is perfect for your Parisian stay. It features 2 bedrooms: one with two single beds that can be pushed together, and one with a double bed. The large living room includes a double sofa bed, allowing up to 6 guests. Fully equipped, with a kitchen, one bathroom, and a separate toilet. It is ideal for families, groups, or professional stays in Paris.The space- Newly renovated- Overlooking a quiet courtyard- Fully equipped kitchen - 3rd floor with elevator- Crib kit (crib + mattress + fitted sheets) is available upon request for 20€ per entire stay.Guest accessEntire homeRegistration details7511016586019
